summary: Specifies several variable-length context headers for NSH metadata type 2. The Network Service Header (RFC 8300) is used in Service Function Chaining to steer packets and carry metadata. These context headers can be used within a Service Function Path. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: Packets traveling through a chain of helper stations carry a tag with notes. This defines more kinds of notes that can be stuck on the tag, in different sizes.

questions: what are nsh md type 2 context headers
how is metadata carried in service function chaining
